hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: The initial operation can choose the first two elements, the last two elements, or the first and last elements.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: This yields at most 3 possible candidate scores: nums[0] + nums[1], nums[-2] + nums[-1], or nums[0] + nums[-1].

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: For each candidate score, run interval dynamic programming with memoization memo[i, j] representing the max operations on subarray nums[i...j].

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Interval dynamic programming for 3 fixed candidate target scores.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exhaustive branching without memoization has 3^(n/2) exponential combinations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n^2) memoization table for subproblem states (i, j).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify that the first move fixes the score, bounding the search to 3 interval DP instances.
